_schema.purpose: Founder-approved product direction. Maker REPLAN only decomposes status:approved epics.

epics.title: Bootstrap Autopilot
epics.goal: Prove Maker/Checker can run one docs-only task end-to-end.
epics.notes: Completed by founder session 2026-08-07 (scaffolds verified; stale audit PRs closed).

epics.title: W35 notes export API
epics.goal: Callers can export a client’s notes as Obsidian-friendly Markdown with wikilinks from note_links.
epics.notes: Additive GET only. No AT graph dogfood in this epic (needs L2 rejection data). Bump API to 0.0.1-w35 already used for PA1.5 OAuth — use 0.0.1-w36 for this ship.

epics.title: Ops: AT1b cron visibility
epics.goal: Operator can confirm supply+poll harnesses are still ticking without Dashboard archaeology.
epics.notes: Read-only report + optional script. Do not change harness cron without founder. L2 dogfood resume deferred 2026-08-07 (founder mid-term portfolio hub takes priority for attention).

epics.title: note_search empty-results investigation
epics.goal: Document why prod note_search can return empty while GET-by-id works; fix if a clear env/code bug.
epics.notes: If root cause needs new embedding provider spend or schema change, open decisions.json and mark needs_human.

epics.title: Personal steward project notes seed
epics.goal: Seed high-value personal-jacky notes for ViOS / melody-thesis / etc.
epics.notes: D-001 → A (2026-08-07): founder + Claude Desktop seed manually. Keep proposed; no Maker tasks.

epics.title: W35b AT graph dogfood (rubric ↔ draft edges)
epics.goal: Link editorial rubric notes to rejected draft notes in AT client graph.
epics.notes: Blocked on L2 green + real rejection corpus. Re-approve when dogfood resumes.

epics.title: Portfolio hub — multi-project reports + instruction dispatch
epics.goal: Orbita as Jacky’s central hub: ingest project reports, brief via chatbot, dispatch agent instructions into each repo for Cursor Autopilot.
epics.notes: Umbrella vision — stays proposed so Maker cannot invent hub direction. Sketch: docs/personal-steward/portfolio-hub.md (+ portfolio-hub-sketch.png). Decompose by approving concrete slices one at a time: E-08 is the first (H2 retrieval). Next candidate slices: report ingest contract (H1, blocked on ai-dev-methodologies contract), instruction dispatch (H3).

epics.title: Notes list/filter for hub briefs
epics.goal: Agents can list notes by project, type, and date range without burning a reasoning loop or losing state across chat sessions.
epics.notes: First approved slice of E-07 (portfolio-hub.md H2). Additive read-only API; do NOT remove or change semantic /notes/search. Founder rationale 2026-08-07: chat sessions get rotated to avoid context overflow, so durable cross-project state must be queryable out of Orbita by a fresh session. Structured retrieval is an agent tool, not a bypass of the agent layer.
